title: Checks for the use of string literals in exception constructors.
summary: Python includes the raise in the default traceback (and formatters like Rich and IPython do too). Ruff takes this rule from flake8-errmsg and made it stable in v0.0.183.
message_templates: Exception must not use a string literal, assign to variable first

summary: Python includes the raise in the default traceback (and formatters like Rich and IPython do too). Ruff takes this rule from flake8-errmsg and made it stable in v0.0.183.

title: Checks for the use of .format calls on string literals in exception constructors.
summary: Python includes the raise in the default traceback (and formatters like Rich and IPython do too). Ruff takes this rule from flake8-errmsg and made it stable in v0.0.183.

title: Check that functions don't have empty bodies outside stubs.
summary: This error code is similar to the [return] code but is emitted specifically for functions and methods with empty bodies (if they are annotated with non-trivial return type). Such a distinction exists because in some contexts an empty body can be valid, for example for an abstract method or in a stub file. mypy enables this error code by default.
